decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan: PKH-P-001. Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, PKH-P-002 Rev A, PKH-P-100 Rev A, PKH-P-101 Rev A, PKH-P-102 Rev A, PKH-P-200 Rev A, PKH-P-300 Rev A, PKH-P-301 Rev A, PKH-P-302 Rev A, PKH-P-303 Rev A, PKH-X-300 Rev A, PKH-X-301 Rev A, PKH-X-302 Rev A, PKH-X-303 Rev A, PKH-X-100 Rev A, PKH-X-101 Rev A, PKH-X-102 Rev A, PKH-X-200 Rev A. Received: 30 April 2017.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension with roof window and replacement of first floor rear window with french doors and juliet balcony to the house
